title: Life Is Roblox (DJ Khaled)
blurb: 'Life is Roblox.' — DJ Khaled's accidental philosophy, from the interview moment where he compared existence to a children's block game and meant it completely. The internet enshrined it instantly: play it when reality glitches, when NPCs appear in daily life, or when the simulation shows its seams. He said what he said. Life is, in fact, Roblox.
origin: DJ Khaled's viral 'life is Roblox' interview moment.
